fix.notes: The description lookup is done from the already-loaded `archetypes` list passed into the constructor, so no additional DB queries are needed. If a deck's `archetype_id` is not found in the archetypes list (e.g. an archetype was deleted), the description falls back to an empty string, which means no tooltip is shown — a safe degradation.
fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

In `/admin/archetypes`, the "Current" and "Matches Rule" columns showed archetype names as links but had no tooltip text, so hovering gave no additional information about what each archetype means.

## What changed

- **`decksite/views/edit_archetypes.py`**: After `rule.apply_rules_to_decks`, build a lookup dict `archetype_descriptions` mapping archetype ID → description from the already-loaded `archetypes` list. Set `d.archetype_description` for the current archetype and `d.rule_archetype_description` for the rule-matched archetype on each queue deck.
- **`decksite/templates/editarchetypes.mustache`**: Added `title='{{archetype_description}}'` to the "Current" link (line 21) and `title='{{rule_archetype_description}}'` to the "Matches Rule" link (line 28), so hovering shows the description as a browser tooltip.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (all checks)
- `uv run --frozen python -m pytest -x -m 'not functional and not perf' --ignore=decksite/scrapers` — 683 passed, 1 skipped

Fixes #12617
